hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — 9, 3. You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Flop — 9, Queen, 10. You bet. Your opponent just called.
Turn — King. You bet again. Your opponent raised you.

wrongReasons: 4 6 is close, but the river lead is the tell. The correct hand picked up more on the river than 4 6 would have.
6 3 has little reason to lead the river here — straight can't comfortably go for value after calling two streets.
Q 9 has little reason to lead the river here — straight can't comfortably go for value after calling two streets.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 9 Q

Your opponent flopped a straight flush and slow-played the flop, calling to disguise their strength. Once the pot was big enough they raised the turn and shoved the river — a classic trap with a monster hand.
